column1: # The declared widths of the live crates, each with its class and its need. Read by `python3 tools/width_census.py` in gate 1.
# A row: the constant's name, the file that declares it, its value, its class and its need (the law that gives the width,
# or the read that will). The classes, with the defects last: exterior, receiver, counted, derived, identity, twin, ruler,
# realization; literal, carrier, dead, picked (tools/width_census.py states each). A width is changed in its source and
# here in one commit, with the need that moved it.
# The ceilings count the defect classes and the literal shift counts of 8 places or more in each crate. They only fall: a
# change that lowers a count lowers its ceiling in the same commit, and a change that raises one says in its record which
# law it could not derive. The campaign (#1088; the record of November 21) ends when picked, carrier, literal

column5: need

the root grain of states, faces, charts and currents. Its law: a reader's grain L holds 2L^2 >= N ln 2 at the reading count N of its admitted future (atlas receiver.grain-lemma), and a state place below what its readers' codes can tell apart is heat. First read: the mask sweep on states (the record of November 21, section 7)
a class's share at a site; the face's grain under a second literal. Same law and read as FACE_BITS

the constitution's grain. Its law is the lattice rule the October machine built and the engine did not take (atlas hnn.receiving-precision-at-grain, hnn.lattice-deposit, hnn.word-sensitivity; hnn/field.rs at d5ed4adc1): a locus's lattice is ceil(log2(2 L_R X)) from its finest receiver's grain and its fan-in, and the deposit's remainder is carried under it at the locus's own clock precision. Reads: the mask sweep on the constitution by block and the spread of a lap's end about its mean (the record of November 21, sections 5 and 7)

a covector's grain. Its law: the places below a section's own spread of the covector are heat (the record of November 7, section 5); read: the covector's spread across sections against its mean, by block
the first moment's grain and its epsilon. Its law (agent-inferred): COVECTOR_BITS plus the places a mean over the moment's memory adds (half a place a doubling of the sections it averages); unread
a code reading's grain in bits. Its law: a read of N places confirms about half of log2 N places (receiver.grain-lemma: 7 at the held passage's 43,470); 20 is finer than any read on record
the contact covector's grain. By its consumers (deposit.rs on_step_grain) it is a covector times a face, COVECTOR_BITS + FACE_BITS (agent-inferred); written so it becomes derived

frames, skins and phasors: chosen so a face fits 32 bits and three faces times an encoding (106) fit 128. Its law: the reader's grain plus the state's top place plus the places its sum's terms add plus one (atlas radix.width-need; radix.face-width-from-readers); about 24 by that count at the line's width, unread
a term's share of its row's mass: one place under a 64-bit word. Its law: the receiver's grain plus the places the row's count of terms adds; unread
the exponential's faces: the widest whose square fits 128 bits. Its law: the grain of the share it forms plus the places its squarings lose (one a squaring); unread
repeats width.rs UNIT_BITS as a private number
the code's grain in bits; one name with a second value in coupling.rs (20). Same law as READ_BITS
its text names it the covector grain (COVECTOR_BITS)
its text names it READ_BITS
a mass's mantissa in one 64-bit word; a mass is a count with its scale (the record of November 10, a count keeps its scale and half its digits)
the closed face's weights, densities and masses; the moves' grain under a second number, with no reader's cut on record
a source's value multiplier, 1 on 2^-62; the card weighs by one and gives the same rational (field.cu, November 15), so the multiplier is a carrier's habit the card has already dropped
MOVE_BITS

the root of CARRY_TURN_BOUND, as a second number

the first moment's rate: the classical 0.9 read as 2^-3. Its law: a rate is a store's state (the method rule of November 13); a moment's memory is the count of sections over which its covector's news stays coherent, read from the cosine of successive covectors by block
the second moment's rate: the classical 0.999 read as 2^-8. Same law as FIRST_RATE
a sentinel past every shift; a step releases to zero from MATERIAL_BITS + 3 up (its text: m/root under 4.2), which is its need
its text derives it: the first moment's grain under a face-grain entry, STEP_BITS - FACE_BITS

the certificate's logarithmic readings; no reader's cut on record
its text proves a reading within one grain and 2^-60 of its value, a need of 2; the third grain is room
three faces on the moves grain: a product adds its grains (radix.width-need)
a coefficient times an encoding
two faces times a covector
the return released to the covector's grain

STATE_BITS

the lock's covector through its base: two faces and one place (its text)
